name: After Hours #16 — Snow at the Shelter
description: The last bus is a rumor. Snow edits the timetable into white. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 16 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 3-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
